entry_sequence.transcript_quote: the first thing I focus on is a stop raid this just means that a low was put in before it was rated or broken
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a stop raid (a low put in before it was taken/broken).
entry_sequence.rationale: Stop raid clears liquidity and confirms initial intent.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: the next thing I look for is a market structure shift or displacement this means that a previous high was broken and aggressively moved over
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a market structure shift or displacement (a previous high/low is broken and aggressively moved over).

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I generally like to see price move back into a discount of this price range here
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to move back into a discount of the displacement range.
entry_sequence.rationale: Discount/Premium range identifies the optimal area for entry.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: the next thing I look for is some sort of PD array where generally I prefer to have a fair value gut or an order block but I will also use an OTE in this area as well as a breaker block
entry_sequence.action: Identify a Point of Interest (POI) using a Fair Value Gap (FVG), Order Block (OB), Breaker Block (BB), or Optimal Trade Entry (OTE).
entry_sequence.rationale: The POI provides the specific setup for entry within the discount/premium range.

strategies.name: General ICT Checklist Strategy
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a Point of Interest (POI) within a discount/premium range, typically using a Fair Value Gap (FVG), Order Block (OB), Breaker Block (BB), or Box setup, after confirming a Stop Raid and Market Structure Shift (MSS).
strategies.exit_summary: Manage risk based on the identified POI, aiming for a favorable Risk-to-Reward ratio, and managing partial entries or moving stops to break even.
